$comment: Scripted capture sessions. The tool drives the procedure so the operator doesn't have to remember it, the tags are correct by construction, and each step is isolated from the last. Both `pleiades procedure` (mode 22, through a dongle) and the CAN sniffer can run these.
$why: Today's belt captures are stuck at 'candidate' because the procedure was improvised — nobody can now say whether each belt stayed fastened as the next went on. A scripted step says 'unbuckle everything, then fasten ONLY the driver belt', and the ambiguity cannot arise.

procedures.name: Doors and tailgate
procedures.note: One opening at a time, closed between each. Every step is checked twice — once when it opens and again when it shuts — so a byte that tracks the door is separated from one that merely happened to move.

steps.do: Open the FRONT LEFT (driver) door. Everything else stays shut.

procedures.name: Seatbelt buckles
procedures.note: Start with every belt unfastened. One at a time, unfastened between — which is exactly the ambiguity that left 0x1046 and 0x1047 unconfirmed the first time round.

steps.do: Unfasten EVERY seatbelt. This is the baseline.
Fasten ONLY the FRONT PASSENGER belt.
Fasten ONLY the REAR LEFT belt.
Fasten ONLY the REAR CENTRE belt.
Fasten ONLY the REAR RIGHT belt.

procedures.name: Exterior lighting
procedures.note: The body integrated unit owns lighting. Ignition in ACC or ON.

steps.undo: Back to low beam, then off.

steps.do: Turn on the REAR FOG light.

procedures.name: Driver controls
procedures.note: Engine running, parked, handbrake on, foot on the brake where asked. Do not select a gear without the brake pressed.

steps.do: Press and HOLD the brake pedal.

procedures.name: Tyre pressure, one corner
procedures.note: Slow: a TPMS sensor may take a minute or two to report, and some only transmit when the wheel is moving. If nothing moves, drive a short distance between captures. Let out ~5 psi — enough to be unambiguous, little enough to pump back easily.

steps.do: Let ~5 psi out of the FRONT LEFT tyre. Wait a minute before continuing.
steps.undo: Re-inflate the front left tyre to placard pressure.
